analysis.title: Embraer (EMBJ): 3Q26 First Take: Solid quarter; 2026 revenue & FCF guidance raised
key_insights: Embraer's 3Q26 revenue of $2.35bn is 7% above FactSet consensus and up 17% yoy, with growth in all four segments.
Adjusted EBITDA of $317mn is above consensus of $285mn. EBITDA margin of 13.5% is 100bps above GS's estimate.
Adjusted free cash flow excluding Eve of $628mn compares with consensus of $178mn.
Segment revenue growth yoy: Commercial +13%, Executive +12%, Defense +22%, Services & Support +30%.
Adjusted EBIT margins by segment: Defense 15.7%, Executive 16.0%, Commercial 2.4%.
Embraer delivered 66 jets in the quarter: 22 commercial (+2 yoy), 41 executive (flat yoy) and 3 defense. Backlog is up 14% yoy and 3% sequentially.

2026 guidance: revenue raised to $8.4-$8.6bn from $8.2-$8.5bn (consensus $8.6bn). Adjusted free cash flow raised to >$700mn from >$400mn (consensus $452mn). Adjusted EBIT margin of 10.0-10.6% and the delivery ranges were reiterated.

GS Buy rating and $90 12-month price target are unchanged. The target is a sum of the parts that implies 13.7x 2027 EV/EBITDA, plus the Eve stake. The stock closed at $77.07 on 9 Nov 2026, 16.8% below the target.
Adjusted EPS of $0.41 is below GS's $0.83 estimate, mainly on interest and debt expense of $159.0mn against GS's $22.9mn.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue, EBITDA and free cash flow beat consensus, and 2026 revenue and free cash flow guidance were raised. Price target of $90 is based on a sum of the parts.

earnings_insights: EMBJ 3Q26 reported 11/10: revenue $2.35bn vs FactSet consensus about 7% lower, up 17.2% yoy. GS's own estimate was $2.15bn.
EMBJ 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA $317mn reported vs consensus $285mn and GS estimate $269mn. Adjusted EBITDA margin 13.5%.
EMBJ 3Q26 adjusted EPS $0.41 reported vs GS estimate $0.83 and $0.46 in 3Q25. The miss comes from interest and debt expense of $159.0mn vs GS's $22.9mn.
EMBJ 3Q26 adjusted free cash flow ex-Eve $628mn reported vs consensus $178mn.

EMBJ 2026 guidance: revenue $8.4-$8.6bn (prior $8.2-$8.5bn, consensus $8.6bn), adjusted EBIT margin 10.0-10.6% (reiterated, consensus 10.2%), adjusted free cash flow >$700mn (prior >$400mn, consensus $452mn).
GS 2026E estimates: revenue $8,587mn, EBITDA $1,118mn, EPS $3.47. 2027E: revenue $9,589mn, EBITDA $1,172mn, EPS $3.84.
